Islam Gymkhana has completely lost its class. The overall environment has become downright shoddy, with poor hygiene and a filthy atmosphere everywhere.

featured_reviews.name: Buccaneer2.0
featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana - 4 Stars 🌟🌟🌟🌟

A historic gem in Mumbai, Islam Gymkhana has stood proudly on Marine Drive since its establishment in 1890, representing more than just sports—it’s a cultural landmark. The lush green lawns outside are nothing short of stunning, offering a serene escape in the heart of the bustling city. 🌳✨

The view? Simply spectacular! Picture this: the expansive sky merging with the Arabian Sea, a golden sunset painting the horizon, the smooth stretch of Marine Drive, and the comforting feel of the grassy lawns underfoot. 🌅🌴 The perfect combination of natural beauty and urban life.

What makes it even more convenient is the location—just steps away from the railway station exit, making it easily accessible for everyone. 🚉 A stroll here feels like stepping into a calm oasis, where the rush of the city meets the soothing sound of the waves. 🌊

Whether you’re here for a game, an event, or just to soak in the peaceful vibes, Islam Gymkhana offers a slice of serenity in the heart of Mumbai’s hustle. Truly a place where history meets beauty!

featured_reviews.name: Ashraf Qureshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Islam Gymkhana is a historic social & sporting club located on Marine Drive.
The land was allotted in 1890, and the club has a large, sea-facing property (around 19,300 sq. m) with both open grounds and built-up areas.
Membership used to be restricted to Muslims but now is open to people of all communities.

featured_reviews.name: Ranajit Das
featured_reviews.review_text: Good ground for cricket. We had our annual cricket matches here this year. Village Cricket League (VCL) is an established tournament in Bandra / Mumbai. I found the ground to be maintained and perfect for summer. Basic amenities are available.

featured_reviews.name: Shahid Momin
featured_reviews.review_text:
Huge Space, Great Vibes! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
The ground is massive—ideal for big weddings. Plenty of room for parking, catering, and a huge stage. Highly recommended for anyone planning a grand celebration

featured_reviews.name: ABBAS ALI ARIF
featured_reviews.review_text: Islam Gymkhana came into existence in 1890, Lord Harris, the then Governor allotted the Islam Gymkhana grounds on the Kennedy Sea Face which is popularly known as Marine Drive and now Netaji Subhas Road. They have Resturant servicing food & snacks for guest. It has a big Ground which can be used for playing cricket, walking or football. They have a AC Banquet Hall to host different functions. They have massage, steam & jacuzzi facility for members. Restroom facility available for members & guest. They have a car parking facility for guest. It is located very close to marine lines railway station.

featured_reviews.name: Cyrus Doodhmal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked away near Churchgate, the Bhikha Behram Well is a quiet oasis amid Mumbai’s bustle.

Built in 1725 by the Parsi Philanthropist Mr. Bhikha Behram, this old freshwater well has stood the test of time, offering both water and solace to those who visit.

Surrounded by trees and a peaceful enclosure, it feels like a step back in time—a place where sunlight filters through the leaves, casting dappled shadows on the worn stone floor.

For the Parsi community, it remains a sacred spot for prayers and reflection, its calm presence untouched by the city’s constant rush.

featured_reviews.name: Kaivan Doctor
featured_reviews.review_text:
It is a heritage well constructed  by a Parsi,situated in Churcgate area.
It has sweet water though close yo the sea.
Entry to well is only for Parsis.
There is a small space in the premises for lighting diyas & praying again only for Parsis.
Water from the well is drawn to a separate fountain which can be consumed  & used by other communities.
Very well maintained  garden with a small waterfall with be ches for sitting & praying.

Water is allowed to be filled in tankers fro the society.

featured_reviews.review_text: I can't put in words how much I appreciate this humble family owned place being where it is, offering God honest tasty Maharashtrian food at honest to God prices. The stars don't do real justice to this place because rating in stars is comparison with other places, and there isn't anything like this place around. The food is good and you can have your fill without breaking bank. 2 real chapatis, 2 pc fry fishes, a half rice a couple small bowls of fish curry and a sol kadhi and my bill was 200, God bless this place.

featured_reviews.name: Amol Pednekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Taste : 3 Stars
Economy : 5 Stars
Ambiance : 3 Stars
Service : 4 Stars
Value For Money : 4 Stars

Gravy items taste was relatively good but fried fish was disappointing. Quantity was also good.

Note : If you are looking for budget Seafood restaurant, then this is the place. You won't get disappointed.

Their rates are really low. You can have a meal in less than Rs. 100.
But taste is average.

featured_reviews.name: nigel faleiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very very economically priced, taste was good too not heavy on stomach, very pleasant experience and quick service.
Seeing the prices on the menu I was wondering if the food or quantity would be any good but I was wrong. The size of the chapatis were bigger than most other expensive places, had a good number of meaty chicken pieces and very less bones 👌🏻
Only gripe was the menu card was dusty

Do keep up the good taste and service

featured_reviews.name: Volney Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: No fuss quantity for the price. Owners actually don't want to make a fortune running this place. They're only earning their daily bread by selling food for so cheap in such an area. Hence, don't complain. Order lot's of fish. Very reasonable prices. A haven for fish lovers.

featured_reviews.name: yuvraj chauhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Okay experience,crab lollipop was good but fish thali was not good(taste) at all...

featured_reviews.name: PETAL SMOOTH
featured_reviews.review_text: Avoid this place. Restaurant is very dirty, service is very poor. Food is served cold especially roti & rice. Their onions are rotten. They don't give additional lemon wedges. There are just two waiters & both are very obnoxious. They clean the table with dirty cloth & with the same dirty hands they serve roti with bare hands. They don't serve roti in a separate dish/basket. They don't have tissues for patrons to clean their dirty cutlery. The kitchen is also very dirty. The manager treats you like why did you come here, if you wouldn't have come then I would have continued my relaxing session. I won't ever go there again.

featured_reviews.name: Mehwish Mujeeb Rehman Shaik
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice balance of quality and quantity. Owner aka Bhau Who's at counter, is greatly humble and gem of a person. Offered extra food for my children, with no extra cost at all. Water service bhau is superbly generous person. Quiet ambience. It was open even after 10.30pm. Bangda fry, bombil fry, yummm... Sea food lovers must visit the place for sure

featured_reviews.name: varun kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Used to be one of the very well maintained joggers track till about 2019 however the park is not being maintained now.
You can see a lot of debris and construction materials lying around.
The park is still used by local for jogging, walking and relaxation by senior citizens.
It is still amongst the good tracks for fitness enthusiast in this area.
Pond is the major attraction at the joggers park, making the the walk/run worthwhile. You can also see a lot of kids and families feeding fishes, turtles and ducks in the pond.
You do have place to sit around the pond incase you just want to enjoy your time with family and friends.

featured_reviews.name: Hiral Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: This jogging track is one of the worst maintained one I have seen in Borivali. It does provide solace and serenity to the people residing nearby and the lake at the centre offers some beautiful natural views. Other than that , this place disappoints due to sheer lack of maintenance

featured_reviews.review_text: It's a very nice well maintained Joggers Park. Good for jogging, walking only. Not for children and family activities. It has drinking water facility, outdoor speakers playing music. Clean.

featured_reviews.name: Sujit Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: A good and peaceful place to jog and workout in the morning around the pond and once you are done just sit and watch the fishes moving in water. But some sort of rule should be made for keeping the pond water clean as one may  find plastic wrappers and beer bottle.

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place to have a morning / evening walk or jog with the multiple marble seats to sit and rest or have a talk or see fishes and turtles in the huge pond  .

featured_reviews.name: Meshva Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a splendid experience here. The Head Chef personally came to take our order and ensured that we received excellent service throughout our visit. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Taronish Mullan
featured_reviews.review_text: Service was ok but food was very disappointing. The paneer tikka was so rubbery and cottage cheese steak was stale. The only nice dishes were Reshmj Murg Tikka and Lobster Thermidor. The restaurant had such a lovely reputation before . If you see the menu on Zomato it is very  Elaborate but when we reached it was a very small menu with limited dishes.

featured_reviews.name: Varundeep Saluja
featured_reviews.review_text: A perfect place for evening date with your beau and a perfect blend of food and ambiance made the evening even more special. The food was lovely and the desserts added more sweetness to my evening. The food was delicious and delicately made with the essence of great flavours and the service added perfection even more. We had a oriental form of cuisine Chinese base and sweet corn soup, frozen litchees and chocolate pastry for the dessert and ginger base and guava base mocktail to accompany. Lovely evening. Hoping to visit here soon.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavin Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Society is one of the finest restaurant in the Iconic and legendary hotel - The Ambassador since 1949 at a 5min walking distance from Churchgate station near Marine Drive. The Society restaurant gives a royal outlook with its grandeur decor, elegant luminous chandeliers and cosy seatings makes this place ideal for a peaceful dining with family and loved ones.
This place is serving delectable delicacies of North Indian and Continental cuisines since 1949 and now Oriental and Asian cuisines adds to their classic menu giving more flavours and culinary aromas to the food lovers. The menu is curated well by their sous chef and executive chef keeping the likings and taste of their guests.
I was fortunate to experience their few asian food dishes of the new oriental menu. All food preparation was finest and perfect with fantastic taste making the dining blissful and memorable.
Oriental food 🍜tried 👇🏻

Soup and Salad
▪️Lemon Coriander soup - A perfect thing to start the meal ... A soup made with veggies like bell pepper, babycorn, carrot, spring onions and zucchini was scrumptious
▪️Tom Yam Phak soup - This soup was made of tomato puree filled in with chopped veggies like mushroom, carrot etc was little greasy but good in terms of taste.
▪️Thai Raw Papaya Salad - This is a must try salad made with grated raw papaya mixed with bell peppers and grounded peanuts tossed with chef special sauce was tasty and healthy.

Appetizers
▪️Cottage cheese with ginger chilly sauce dry was an amazing soft paneer starter tossed in ginger chilly sauce and garnished with seasame seeds was yumm and totally awesome. (must try)
▪️Spring Roll - A well prepared fried rolls stuffed with grated carrot and cabbage was good in terms of taste.
▪️Baby Corn Salt & Papper - Deep fried babycorns cooked with spring onions, celery, ginger, garlic and plenty of black peppercorns was moreish and flavoursome.

Mains
▪️Yang Chow FriedRice - A fried rice with chopped veggies and cut roasted cashews were palatable.
▪️Water chestnuts with Green Pepper in sweet bean chilly sauce was delicious gravy preparation that added more taste with fried rice.

Mocktails
▪️Blue Heaven - A fizzy Mocktail made of blue curacao, lime and soda served in tall glass was iced and refreshing.
▪️Strawberry Sorbet - A perfectly made Margarita with crushed ice in strawberry flavour was chilled, sweet and awesome in taste.

Dessert 🍮
▪️Batter Fried Apple with honey served with vanilla icecream was something different and yummy. A great dessert to end the delish meal

The hospitality was superb right from warm greeting when I entered the place followed by royal treatment in terms of service by well mannered staff.
An Excellent and Elite place to enjoy drinks and food.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Anuja G
featured_reviews.review_text:
The ambience was cozy and vintage we liked the low key vibe it was comfortable.
The food was good too, our server akash ubale was courteous and served us well.

Chef Sandeep was sweet enough to enquire us about food and experience and was friendly we liked the gesture.

However, we dint really like the approach of Captain Mahesh Sharma, we felt his attitude was a bit off towards us.
His body language was unfriendly and it made us feel unwanted at the place.

The management should take note of the above mentioned.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Kolhe
featured_reviews.review_text:
'The Society Restaurant at Ambassador Hotel' is definitely amongst one of the best places you can visit in Mumbai.

We were here for a small meeting on a lunch but really had a great time over here.

This is an outstanding place to have meetings or even spend some great time out with your gang accompanied by amazing food, brilliant drinks, and the music in background.

Special thanks to the staff for the hospitality and courteous service.

The best dishes and drinks we liked and would surely suggest would be the;

1. Peppery Hot Prawns.

2. Cottage Cheese in Ginger.

3. Dim-Sums Shu-Kai Style.

4. Chicken Schnitzel.

5. Escalope of Vegetable Paprika.

6. Malai Kulfi.

The Society Restaurant is a great place to spend some valuable time with your friends or Family, would highly recommend it.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Davda
featured_reviews.review_text:
The phrase  “ Old is Gold “ truly applies to Ambassador Hotel located in Churchgate

Visited Society Restaurant inside Ambassador Hotel after ages to try their new oriental cuisine & the moment you step in you’ll be blown away with the elegance & class this place possesses.

My Veg Order was as follows : -

STARTERS

* Cottage Cheese in ginger chilli garlic sauce - Soft , Chunky pieces of paneer tossed in medium spicy chilli paste with the addition of ginger .
* Spring roll - 6 decent pieces of traditional spring rolls served with salad dressing, chilli & Schezwan sauce.

MAINS

* Gang kiew warn - Similar to Thai green curry which was served with steam rice. Mild in taste & flavours were well balanced. Blended beautifully with steam rice 🍚

* Assorted vegetables with Schezwan
Fresh assorted veggies such as broccoli, spinash, asparagus, pok choy & baby corn tossed in Schezwan gravy . Spicy & tasty 😋

DESSERT

* Chilled lychee with ice cream - Fresh & chilled lychee layered between their in house ice cream.

MOCKTAIL

* Appletini - Non alcoholic version of Apple martini which contains ice, apple syrup & club soda with a couple of apple slices put on top.

The decor oozes with elegance, beautiful wall paintings, traditional Chandeliers & soothing music playing in the background.

In terms of food quality, quantity & service the resturant is flawless & provides a memorable food experience.

Had a memorable dinner experience.

featured_reviews.name: Pankaj Kaklotar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A place that will take you back to the vintage Mumbai (Bombay)

The Society one of the restaurants and part of  ambassador hotel, is very classy and has very soothing ambience. We went to this place for a Saturday Lunch and we spent almost 3 to 4 hours talking, enjoying food and drinks.! Definitely one of the best place which will make you indulge in your conversations with friends, family and you won't realize the time.!

Talking more about Ambience, the society is a fine dine restaurant which makes you super comfortable in terms of seating! Beautiful bar counter, some green plants in corners and overall calmness flows through the place.!

Staff and Service! Mr. Om just made our day by that warm welcome with a big smile on his face. Staff at this place was very polite and well trained. Service was satisfying.!

Food and Drinks! Place offers a wide range of continental and oriental cuisines.! We just tried their oriental menu and it was satisfying overall. We could try few dishes, everything was prepared with fresh and high quality ingredients.!

Som tam - a very popular raw papaya salad with some cherry tomatoes and lot of spices.! Yeah, this is medium spicy salad with lot of health benifits.! If you haven't tried this one yet, go for it.!

Clear wonton soup - soup was good overall only thing I found wrong according to me was excessive layers of wonton in the soup.! If that could be little lesser would make it perfect. Taste wise it was perfect.!

Cottage cheese & Mushroom in Ginger chilly sauce - fresh cottage cheese and juicy mushrooms tossed perfectly in hot and spicy ginger chilly sauce, served piping hot, this was absolutely delightful.
*** Highly Recommended ***

Dimsums (shu mai style) - open head dimsums make it easy to stuff with sauces of choice and were perfectly steamed with fresh veggies stuffing.! Taste wise it was upto the mark.!

Eggplant cakes in hot bean sauce - so many dishes are there which would change your perception about eggplant.! This is one of them.! Those deep fried cakes were perfectly crisp and hot bean sauce was just enhancing taste like anything.! Overall a delicious dish.!

Waterchestnut in a sweet bean sauce - who all are fans of waterchestnuts? Don't miss this super delicious mains with juicy waterchestnuts and sweet bean sauce. Goes very well with the fried rice.!

Veg. Fried Rice - to accompany waterchestnuts and eggplant cake we ordered a veg friend rice. It was perfect fried rice I would say! Vegetables and rice everything in appropriate proportion.!

Whatever the scenario may be! There is always space for some desserts.! The Society has few unique and delightful desserts.!

Fried pan cakes - pan cakes stuffed with dates and deep fried! Served along with chocolate decor.! Tastes amazing and that crispness makes it more enjoyable.! Loved the presentation.!

Overall, a very calm place with some delicious otiental and continental delicacies. A good place for casual and official meet ups.!

featured_reviews.name: Wilma D'Cunha
featured_reviews.review_text: Oh Yes! Like all the food festivals in and around Mumbai I also attended this food festival. Located about 2kms from Borivali station a small festival from Koli people which had about 8 to 10 stalls all sea food and chicken too. From one of the stalls took chicken for Rs.150, the stuffed fish fry for Rs.200 and rice roti for Rs.35 each. The price was too high for all this stuff still i thought that may be it would taste good as done by the locals hence took. The oil used for cooking is of very low quality and the it was tasteless and the fish fry was just stuffed with couloured tasteless coconut. Ate just the half of it as couldn't eat futher. May be the other stalls there served good cannot say as didn't like it and did take from any other stall. Guys please if you to experience this then please do post it instead of these people feeding you wrong. The picture may be good that i posted but go on it. Just giving it a three star as there were other stalls too.
